transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining. We're here to review Harbor Point Properties' restructuring proposal. As you know, they've requested a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral on the $8 million term loan. Before I can record final terms, I need each of you to walk through your findings — risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management. Jonas, I'll specifically need your covenant-testing findings and the applicable workout policy citation for the meeting minutes. Let's work through each area systematically so we can determine the appropriate treatment. Who would like to start?
